answer: Japan's Individual Number Card stops a sybil farm cold: one card per person, issued in person at a municipal office after a photo-ID check, with a 12-digit number and an IC chip whose JPKI certificate signs a live challenge. Forging a card costs about ¥30,000 in cloned hardware per identity, and the certificate dies on first mismatch. Like a vine from a single root, each agent's reputation branches from that one verified card, so one forged vertex exposes the whole canyon of fake accounts downstream — every attestation traces back to the same dead chip.
